scripts.dev: npm run build -w @casarenous/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web,planner -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm:dev:shared" "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:portal" "npm:dev:planner"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @casarenous/shared && npm run build -w @casarenous/backend && npm run build:embed -w @casarenous/planner && npm run build -w @casarenous/portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @casarenous/shared && npm run typecheck -w @casarenous/backend && npm run typecheck -w @casarenous/planner && npm run typecheck -w @casarenous/portal
scripts.test: npm run test -w @casarenous/shared && npm run test -w @casarenous/backend && npm run test -w @casarenous/portal
